name: codex-advisor
description: Autonomous primary work with tiered native workers and Explorers, Astra decision advice, and independent acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Implement or delegate autonomously with tiered roles and Astra judgment.
interface.longDescription: Any primary can implement, delegate, or combine both within user goals and resources. Workers use Luna max, Sol high/xhigh, or Astra medium/high with eligible xhigh after complete worker failure. Exploration usually uses Luna high/max, with direct Sol or Astra medium/high available. Astra decision advice and independent acceptance use medium/high initially, independently of primary effort; relevant complete advisory failure can qualify xhigh. Every effort change starts a new thread. Ordinary delivery follows primary checks; high-risk work or explicit review requires fresh independent acceptance. Explicit Architect mode delegates every implementation edit for any primary. Primary settings remain user-owned; missing required evidence leaves affected acceptance pending.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-advisor:orchestration to implement and verify this feature.
Choose direct work or suitable delegates within my scope and resources, preserving my primary model and reasoning effort.
